notes.title: Demo & Playtest build 625: Improved high-res support, game recording
notes.content:
Hi all,

I've just pushed build 625 for the playtest and demo version of the game. These patches include:

Both demo & playtest:
- Improved scaling for high res monitors
- Some buttons on the main menu would previously hang until the popup was closed. This has been fixed.

Playtest (& full game) only:
- Added game recording. All your games will automatically be recorded into standard PGN(Portable Game Notation) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portable_Game_Notation
Games can later be analyzed an assortment of free tools to help you develop your skills.

notes.title: Demo & Playtest build 610: Performance improvements & more.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I have just released build 610 for both the demo and playtest versions of the game. The main fixes include:
- Improved performance on Windows when in fullscreen mode
- Improved formatting of times less than 10 seconds
- An assortment of other performance related improvements
